ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Lyon on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Lyon
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Lyon it currently holds 253 public toilets and 380 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: 520 places in Lyon are recorded as having step-free access.
